sentences.text:
Heard Sri Kamlesh Singh, learned counsel for applicants and Sri R.K.Singh, learned A.G.A. on behalf of State.
2. Applicant no.1 is husband of O.P. No.2, wheres applicant nos.2 3, and 4 are his close relatives.
3. Applicants no.1 to 3. are being summoned under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506 of I.P.C. and of D.P.Act, whereas applicant no.4 has been summoned under Section 354-A of I.P.C. by impugned order dated 4.7.2023 under Section 204 Cr.P.C.
Prashant Kumar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8577182/
1
4. Learned counsel for the applicants by referring the complaint filed by complainant submitted that dates mentioned therein do not support contents of application.

5. Learned counsel for the applicants further submitted that allegations made against applicant no.4 of outraging modesty of complainant is alleged to have occurred on 9.5.2023 by the complainant in her statement recorded under Section 200 Cr.P.C., whereas in the complaint such alleged occurrence is being mentioned to have occurred on 3.9.2023 i.e. there is vital contradiction in the said statement.

He further referred that so far as allegation of demand of dowry, assault and intimidation to provoke to commit breach of peace is concerned are omnibus and general in nature.
Only statement made by the complainant is that applicants have demanded additional dowry.
No date, month or year has been mentioned in the complaint.
He further submitted that statement of witnesses recorded under Section 202 Cr.P.C. also are allegations which remains omnibus and general in nature.
6. In order to appreciate above submissions, I have carefully perused materials available on record and for reference, impugned order is reproduced hereinafter:

sentences.text: 7. There is a merit in the argument of learned counsel for applicants that no date, month or year has been mentioned in the complaint filed by the complainant as well as that there are omnibus and general allegations against applicant no.1 and his family members.

8. Learned Trial Court has not even mentioned statement of witnesses recorded under Section 202 Cr.P.C. even in brief, therefore, Court is of considered opinion that reasons assigned to summon the applicants under aforesaid sections are absent.

9. In aforesaid circumstances impugned order dated 4.7.2023 (probably it would be 4.7.2024)
passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shikohabad, Firozabad in Complaint Case No.2376 of 2023 (Smt. Sapna Vs. Prashant Kumar & Ors) under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506 of I . P . C . , S e c t i o n 3 / 4 o f D .

P . C . , P o l i c e Station-Sirsaganj,District-Firozabad pending in the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shikohabad, Firozabad is hereby set-aside.

sentences.text: However, considering that this order is passed without issuing notice to O.P. No.2, therefore, this application is remanded back to learned Trial Court to pass a fresh order after hearing the complainant and taking note of above referred observations within a period of three months from today.
10. With aforesaid observations/direction, this application is disposed of.
11. Registrar (Compliance) to take steps.
